technique_name: Describe the interior of a spaceship.
description: The interior of a spaceship is typically sleek and minimalistic, with bright, clean surfaces and soft glowing lights. There is a variety of control consoles and monitors for monitoring, tracking and controlling a spacecraft. There may also be displays for entertainment and communication purposes. The walls usually have a cushioning material to protect the astronauts from any shocks or vibrations that may occur as the spacecraft moves through space.
